Name: miKey's Premium Coop and Barn plus Winery Recolor Mod for Stardew Expanded
Author: flaxter2001
Description:
I have recolored the premium coop/barn and winery included in [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]FlashShifter's incredible Stardew Valley Expanded Mod[/url].

Downloads.Description: Open your Stardew Valley Expanded > assets > Buildings folder and replace the original .png files with the provided .pngs.
